title: From a hackathon idea to the Play Store
summary: Frésko reached the grand finals of a student hackathon in 2024. Two years later it's StillGood, a real app on Google Play.
notes: DRAFT written from the Frésko and StillGood case studies. Add: what the judges said, what you changed from the hackathon design and why, your teammates' names if they're happy to be named.
